evals.prompt: We ran explore-llm-tools-and-permissions yesterday and now want to run the excessive-agency audit - where does it pick up that map from, and where should its findings land?
evals.expected_output: Names audit/llm/explore/explore-llm-tools-and-permissions.json as the map path and audit/findings/audit-llm-excessive-agency.json (via audit-finding-writer) as the findings path, and explains findings reuse the existing contract rather than a new LLM-specific one.

evals.prompt: propose-llm-controls just produced some fixes - what file do those live in and how do they trace back to the findings that justified them?
